title: 微软云业务增速创2022年来最快，Azure年化收入破千亿
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: To start on Microsoft, I feel like it's probably the most tangible, right?
segments.zh: 先说微软，我觉得它可能是最直观的例子，对吧？

segments.en: So everything is in the cloud growth, better than expectations and, you know, the math was really simple going into this.
segments.zh: 云业务增长超预期，而且财报前的计算其实很简单。

segments.en: They've just closed the book on their fiscal financial year.
And the question still remains, when we get to the call, what does Microsoft tell us about the capital expenditure growth into next year?
segments.zh: 问题在于，电话会上微软会如何展望明年的资本支出增长？

segments.en: Because the street sees CapEx growing beyond 50%.
segments.zh: 因为市场预期资本支出增长超过50%。

segments.en: Top-line growth on Azure is 43% give or take XTAC.
All the street really wants to see is that pace of growth, being near to CapEx growth, right?
segments.zh: 市场真正想看到的是增速接近资本支出增速，对吧？

segments.en: It's a really simple equation, but going back to alphabet, which is highly analogous, there's so much commentary here from Microsoft about traction with co-pilot,
segments.zh: 公式很简单，但回顾高度类似的Alphabet，微软关于Copilot进展的评论很多。

segments.en: like more data points that are just easy, tangible to understand about how Microsoft's AI efforts are going, right?
segments.zh: 更多直观易懂的数据点展示了微软AI的进展。

segments.en: That's the stock reflecting that and after ours. Is the 30 million paid seats a big deal for 365 co-pilot for Microsoft?
segments.zh: 股价反映了这一点。3000万付费席位对365 Copilot来说意义重大吗？

segments.en: Yes, because it's versus 20 million at the end of March, exactly what I'm pointing to.
segments.zh: 是的，因为对比3月底的2000万，这正是我指出的。

segments.en: The other one is, I think you guys mentioned this, but like Nadella was talking about Azure generating more than $100 billion in annualized revenue.
segments.zh: 另一个是，你们提到过，纳德拉说Azure年化收入超1000亿美元。

segments.en: You know, remember, Amazon went to that figure very early, you know, in its kind of like growth of AWS, then what Amazon did,
segments.zh: 记得亚马逊很早就达到这个数字，在AWS增长期，然后亚马逊的做法是——

segments.en: they report tomorrow, but was to say this is the AI specific annualized revenues.
segments.zh: 他们明天公布财报，但会提到这是AI相关的年化收入。
